---
title: "04.Multi_ARG_hosts_CIA"
author: "Diego Coleto"
date: "2026-10-20"
output: html_document
---

Multi-ARG contigs (≥ 2 distinct ARGs): bacterial hosts, ARG combinations, WHO critical ARGs and mobility.

1. Are multi-ARG contigs enriched in critical ARGs, plasmids and mobile elements compared with single-ARG contigs?
   Logistic mixed models at contig level: outcome ~ multi-ARG + log(contig length) + (1 | sample).
   The contrast is between contigs of the same samples, so sample-level covariates (sex, age, BMI, depth) are
   not added: they do not vary between the contigs being compared and the sample random effect absorbs
   between-sample differences in carriage.
2. Which hosts carry multi-ARG contigs: genus enrichment among ARG contigs with the same mixed model
   (multi-ARG ~ genus + log(contig length) + (1 | sample)), because contigs are nested in participants; BH.
3. Recurrent ARG combinations: hosts, critical genes, mobility and diet groups (alluvial plot and table).

# Data load

```{r data load}
arg_contigs <- read_tsv(file.path(table_dir, "arg_contigs.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
arg_hits <- read_tsv(file.path(table_dir, "arg_hits.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
metadata <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "metadata.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

arg_contigs <- arg_contigs %>%
  left_join(metadata %>% select(sample_id, diet_group), by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(diet_group = factor(diet_group, levels = names(diet_colors)),
         contig_type = if_else(multi_ARG, "Multi-ARG", "Single ARG"),
         genus = replace_na(genus, "Unassigned"))

multi_contigs <- arg_contigs %>% filter(multi_ARG)
cat("Multi-ARG contigs:", nrow(multi_contigs), "in", n_distinct(multi_contigs$sample_id), "samples\n")
```


# 1. Multi-ARG vs single-ARG contigs

```{r enrichment models}
enrichment_outcomes <- c(
  "has_critical"         = "Critical ARG",
  "has_highest_priority" = "Highest-priority ARG",
  "is_plasmid"           = "Plasmid",
  "has_mobile_element"   = "Mobile element")

enrichment <- imap_dfr(enrichment_outcomes, function(label, outcome) {
  # Critical carriage is partly by construction on multi-ARG contigs: the model also reports it per ARG count
  fit <- glmmTMB(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ multi_ARG + log_contig_length + (1 | sample_id)")),
                 data = arg_contigs, family = binomial)
  tidy(fit, effects = "fixed", exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term == "multi_ARGTRUE") %>%
    transmute(outcome = label, odds_ratio = estimate, conf_low = conf.low, conf_high = conf.high, p_value = p.value)
}) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
         # "Mobile element" here is the broad flag: any MAP annotation on the contig
         outcome_definition = c("At least one WHO-critical ARG (CIA, HPCIA or human use only)",
                                "At least one ARG for HPCIA or human-use-only antimicrobials",
                                "Contig classified as plasmid by geNomad",
                                "Any MGE annotation from MAP (broad flag)"))

enrichment_descriptive <- arg_contigs %>%
  group_by(contig_type) %>%
  summarise(contigs = n(), samples = n_distinct(sample_id), across(all_of(names(enrichment_outcomes)), mean)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(contig_type, contigs, samples), names_to = "outcome", values_to = "proportion") %>%
  mutate(outcome = enrichment_outcomes[outcome])

enrichment
```

The same enrichment for the complementary MASTER CIA gene list (`Data/Scripts/06`), on the variant each hit
matched.

```{r master enrichment}
master_variants <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "arg_cia_list_mapping.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene)) %>%
  distinct(gene) %>%
  pull(gene)
arg_hits <- arg_hits %>% mutate(master_cia = AMR_variant %in% master_variants)
arg_contigs <- arg_contigs %>%
  left_join(arg_hits %>% group_by(sample_id, contig_id) %>% summarise(has_master_cia = any(master_cia), .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("sample_id", "contig_id"))
stopifnot(!anyNA(arg_contigs$has_master_cia))

fit_master <- glmmTMB(has_master_cia ~ multi_ARG + log_contig_length + (1 | sample_id), data = arg_contigs,
                      family = binomial)
master_enrichment <- tidy(fit_master, effects = "fixed", exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term == "multi_ARGTRUE") %>%
  transmute(outcome = "MASTER CIA ARG", odds_ratio = estimate, conf_low = conf.low, conf_high = conf.high,
            p_value = p.value, converged = isTRUE(fit_master$sdr$pdHess))
master_per_hit <- arg_hits %>%
  left_join(arg_contigs %>% select(sample_id, contig_id, contig_type), by = c("sample_id", "contig_id")) %>%
  group_by(contig_type) %>%
  summarise(ARG_hits = n(), master_cia = mean(master_cia), .groups = "drop")
master_enrichment
master_per_hit
```

## Is the critical-ARG enrichment just combinatorics?

A contig carrying two ARGs has two chances of one of them being critical, so part of the odds ratio above is
arithmetic rather than biology. Two checks:

1. **Per ARG, not per contig.** The fraction of individual ARG hits that are critical cannot be inflated by
   the number of genes on the contig.
2. **Permutation null.** Reshuffle which ARG hits land on which contig while keeping each contig's number of
   ARGs, and recompute the odds ratio. The null is the enrichment expected from counting alone.
   - Statistic: crude odds ratio of carrying at least one WHO-critical ARG, multi-ARG vs single-ARG contigs.
   - Permuted: the WHO-critical labels of the 3,074 ARG hits, pooled across all participants.
   - Held fixed: the number of hits on each contig (so each contig's multi-ARG status) and the total number of
     critical hits.
   - Null hypothesis: critical hits fall on contigs independently of how many ARGs the contig carries.
   - The pooled null ignores that critical genes are commoner in some participants than in others. A
     sensitivity null permutes the labels within each participant only, which also holds fixed each
     participant's number of critical hits.

```{r per gene}
# Fraction of the ARG hits that are critical, single vs multi-ARG contigs
hits_by_type <- arg_hits %>%
  left_join(arg_contigs %>% select(sample_id, contig_id, contig_type), by = c("sample_id", "contig_id")) %>%
  group_by(contig_type) %>%
  summarise(ARG_hits = n(), critical = mean(who_critical), highest_priority = mean(who_highest_priority))
hits_by_type
```

```{r permutation null}
set.seed(1)
n_permutations <- 999

hit_key <- arg_hits %>%
  select(sample_id, contig_id, who_critical) %>%
  left_join(arg_contigs %>% select(sample_id, contig_id, multi_ARG), by = c("sample_id", "contig_id"))
contig_sizes <- hit_key %>%
  count(sample_id, contig_id, name = "n_hits") %>%
  left_join(arg_contigs %>% select(sample_id, contig_id, multi_ARG), by = c("sample_id", "contig_id"))

crude_odds_ratio <- function(multi, critical) {
  tab <- table(factor(multi, c(FALSE, TRUE)), factor(critical, c(FALSE, TRUE)))
  (tab["TRUE", "TRUE"] / tab["TRUE", "FALSE"]) / (tab["FALSE", "TRUE"] / tab["FALSE", "FALSE"])
}

observed_or <- crude_odds_ratio(arg_contigs$multi_ARG, arg_contigs$has_critical)
contig_index <- rep(seq_len(nrow(contig_sizes)), contig_sizes$n_hits)

null_or <- replicate(n_permutations, {
  shuffled <- sample(hit_key$who_critical)
  crude_odds_ratio(contig_sizes$multi_ARG, tapply(shuffled, contig_index, any))
})

enrichment_null <- tibble(
  observed_odds_ratio = observed_or,
  null_median = median(null_or),
  null_low = quantile(null_or, 0.025),
  null_high = quantile(null_or, 0.975),
  excess_over_null = observed_or / median(null_or),
  p_empirical = (sum(null_or >= observed_or) + 1) / (n_permutations + 1))

enrichment_null %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3)))

# Sensitivity: permute within participant. Hits are ordered as contig_sizes (sample, contig) so that the
# contig index lines up with each hit.
hit_key_sorted <- hit_key %>% arrange(sample_id, contig_id)
stopifnot(identical(rle(paste(hit_key_sorted$sample_id, hit_key_sorted$contig_id))$lengths, contig_sizes$n_hits))
set.seed(2)
null_or_within <- replicate(n_permutations, {
  shuffled <- unsplit(lapply(split(hit_key_sorted$who_critical, hit_key_sorted$sample_id),
                             function(z) z[sample.int(length(z))]),
                      hit_key_sorted$sample_id)
  crude_odds_ratio(contig_sizes$multi_ARG, tapply(shuffled, contig_index, any))
})
enrichment_null_within <- tibble(
  null = "Within participant",
  observed_odds_ratio = observed_or,
  null_median = median(null_or_within),
  null_low = quantile(null_or_within, 0.025),
  null_high = quantile(null_or_within, 0.975),
  excess_over_null = observed_or / median(null_or_within),
  p_empirical = (sum(null_or_within >= observed_or) + 1) / (n_permutations + 1))
enrichment_null_within
cat("\nAbout", round(median(null_or), 1), "of the odds ratio is expected from gene counting alone;",
    "the per-ARG comparison (", round(hits_by_type$critical[hits_by_type$contig_type == "Multi-ARG"] * 100, 1),
    "% vs", round(hits_by_type$critical[hits_by_type$contig_type == "Single ARG"] * 100, 1),
    "% of hits critical) is not affected by it.\n")
```

```{r enrichment plot}
plot_enrichment <- enrichment_descriptive %>%
  mutate(outcome = factor(outcome, levels = enrichment_outcomes),
         contig_type = factor(contig_type, levels = c("Single ARG", "Multi-ARG"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = outcome, y = proportion, fill = contig_type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = enrichment %>% mutate(outcome = factor(outcome, levels = enrichment_outcomes)),
            aes(x = outcome, y = 1.02,
                label = paste0("OR = ", round(odds_ratio, 2),
                               if_else(p_adj < 0.001, "***", if_else(p_adj < 0.01, "**", if_else(p_adj < 0.05, "*", ""))))),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3, vjust = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Single ARG" = "#B8B8B8", "Multi-ARG" = "#A23E48"), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1.1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of ARG contigs",
       subtitle = "OR: multi-ARG vs single-ARG contigs, adjusted for log(contig length), sample as random effect; BH q") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom", plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey30"))

plot_enrichment
```


# 2. Hosts of multi-ARG contigs

```{r host enrichment}
assigned_contigs <- arg_contigs %>% filter(genus != "Unassigned")

# Each genus against all other assigned genera
fit_host <- function(focal_genus) {
  fit <- glmmTMB(multi_ARG ~ focal + log_contig_length + (1 | sample_id),
                 data = assigned_contigs %>% mutate(focal = genus == focal_genus), family = binomial)
  tidy(fit, effects = "fixed", exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term == "focalTRUE") %>%
    transmute(odds_ratio = estimate, conf_low = conf.low, conf_high = conf.high, p_value = p.value)
}

host_enrichment <- assigned_contigs %>%
  group_by(genus) %>%
  summarise(ARG_contigs = n(), multi_ARG_contigs = sum(multi_ARG),
            samples = n_distinct(sample_id), samples_multi = n_distinct(sample_id[multi_ARG]), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(multi_ARG_contigs >= 3) %>%
  mutate(prop_multi = multi_ARG_contigs / ARG_contigs,
         fit = map(genus, fit_host)) %>%
  unnest(fit) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(p_value)

host_enrichment
```

```{r host plot}
plot_hosts <- host_enrichment %>%
  mutate(genus = fct_reorder(genus, multi_ARG_contigs),
         label = paste0(multi_ARG_contigs, "/", ARG_contigs,
                        if_else(p_adj < 0.05, " *", ""))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = multi_ARG_contigs, y = genus)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = prop_multi), colour = "black", linewidth = 0.25, width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F3E0E2", high = "#A23E48", labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1),
                      name = "Multi-ARG / ARG contigs") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
  labs(x = "Multi-ARG contigs", y = NULL,
       subtitle = "Genera with ≥ 3 multi-ARG contigs; * enriched vs other genera (mixed logistic model, BH q < 0.05)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey30"))

plot_hosts
```


# 3. ARG combinations

```{r combinations}
combination_summary <- multi_contigs %>%
  group_by(ARG_combination) %>%
  summarise(n_ARG = first(n_ARG),
            contigs = n(),
            samples = n_distinct(sample_id),
            omnivore = sum(diet_group == "Omnivore"),
            vegetarian = sum(diet_group == "Vegetarian"),
            vegan = sum(diet_group == "Vegan"),
            critical_genes = first(critical_genes),
            highest_category = first(highest_category),
            plasmid = mean(is_plasmid),
            mobile = mean(has_mobile_element),
            hosts = paste(names(sort(table(species), decreasing = TRUE)), collapse = "; "),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(contigs), desc(samples))

combination_summary %>% slice_head(n = 20)
```

```{r alluvial, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 8}
top_genera <- multi_contigs %>% filter(genus != "Unassigned") %>% count(genus, sort = TRUE) %>% slice_head(n = 10) %>% pull(genus)
top_combinations <- combination_summary %>% filter(contigs >= 3) %>% pull(ARG_combination)

alluvial_data <- multi_contigs %>%
  mutate(Host = case_when(genus %in% top_genera ~ genus,
                          genus == "Unassigned" ~ "Unassigned",
                          TRUE ~ "Other genera"),
         Combination = if_else(ARG_combination %in% top_combinations, ARG_combination, "Other combinations"),
         `WHO category` = factor(highest_category, levels = names(category_colors))) %>%
  count(Host, Combination, `WHO category`, name = "contigs") %>%
  mutate(Host = factor(Host, levels = c(top_genera, "Other genera", "Unassigned")),
         Combination = factor(Combination, levels = c(top_combinations, "Other combinations")))

plot_alluvial <- ggplot(alluvial_data,
                        aes(axis1 = Host, axis2 = Combination, axis3 = `WHO category`, y = contigs)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = `WHO category`), width = 1/4, alpha = 0.75, knot.pos = 0.4) +
  geom_stratum(width = 1/4, fill = "grey95", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum)), size = 2.6) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Host genus", "ARG combination", "Highest WHO category"), expand = c(0.08, 0.08)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = category_colors, name = "Highest WHO category", drop = TRUE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Multi-ARG contigs") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        legend.position = "bottom")

plot_alluvial
```

```{r combinations by diet}
# Most frequent combinations: contigs per diet group, as % of the multi-ARG contigs of each diet
combinations_diet <- multi_contigs %>%
  filter(ARG_combination %in% head(top_combinations, 12)) %>%
  count(diet_group, ARG_combination, name = "contigs") %>%
  left_join(multi_contigs %>% count(diet_group, name = "total"), by = "diet_group") %>%
  mutate(percentage = contigs / total,
         ARG_combination = factor(ARG_combination, levels = rev(head(top_combinations, 12))))

plot_combinations_diet <- ggplot(combinations_diet, aes(x = percentage, y = ARG_combination, fill = diet_group)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diet_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = "% of the multi-ARG contigs of each diet group", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8.5), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")

plot_combinations_diet
```
